cond_0001.intro:
The Human Resource Analytics team at [Company name masked] leads the organization's understanding of workforce insights and organizational health. Our team uncovers holistic data-driven business opportunities across the talent lifecycle to enable transformational change and operational efficiency. We analyze internal and external data to understand diverse employee voices, and experiment to scale solutions that make the work experience better.
The ideal candidate sees beyond the numbers to find opportunities to strengthen the employee experience and organizational performance. The candidate is relentless problem-solver, innovator and change agent who can translate complex sets of information into actionable talent and culture intelligence. They are responsible for partnership and communication with business clients on workplace insights: diagnosis, hypothesis testing, analysis, visualization, and presentation. They will guide business leaders with data-driven recommendations that improve performance, retention, and organizational agility. The candidate possesses strong quantitative skills, is capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously, and can communicate effectively to a wide-ranging audience. In addition, the candidate is comfortable working with technology partners as the voice of business to collect business and functional requirements to enhance relevant programs. An ""outside in"" perspective, high intellectual curiosity, and a consultative posture are essential skills to possess in this role.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
The HR Data Science Consultant at [Company name masked] will:
Rapidly perform exploratory data analysis, generate and test working hypotheses, and uncover trends and relationships to support workforce planning efforts; provide descriptive and advanced analyses on workforce and workplace priorities.
Synthesize business goals and strategy with HR, productivity, and market data to build integrated, tangible recommendations on talent and culture topics.
Communicate results of analysis to stakeholders; employ storytelling techniques to make recommendations, moving from the ""so what"" and ""now what,"" to drive impact; develop executive presentations and dashboards for recurring and ad hoc workforce measurement needs.
Build technology and analytical solutions that anticipate business needs across workforce and workplace dimensions; drive digital solutions for self-service.
Project manage key initiatives that drive efficiency and value.
Assist with change management efforts to scale HR analytics solutions across the enterprise.
Assist in development, execution, and evaluation of client OKRs, human capital KPIs and other measurement strategies to enable business results.
Partner and train clients and HR stakeholders on impactful use of data and data literacy techniques to drive business outcomes. Provide guidance on business priorities and opportunities for replication of solutions and self-service to HRA partners.
Advise on enterprise-level and business unit level analytics work with analytics partners through the organization; contribute to enterprise data governance methods and priorities.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Creative and strategic thinker - ability to assess needs, collaborate, and deliver data-driven, practical solutions that drive results
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills - approaches problems with rigorous logic and a curious mind – looks beyond the obvious and searches for deeper answers
Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences – tells stories with data that resonate with stakeholders and maximize impact; excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple client groups simultaneously; strong project management background
Highly proficient in Excel and PowerPoint
Proficient in data querying languages (e.g., SQL), database management systems, and employee listening platforms (e.g., Perceptyx, Glint)
Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., Python) and/or mathematical/statistical software (e.g., R), and other advanced analytical tools (e.g., Sagemaker, Tableau, PowerBI, Quicksight, Visier, Alteryx)
Applied statistics or experimentation (A/B testing)
Strong decision-making skills; stellar interpersonal, relationship building, and collaboration skills
Highly-organized with strong attention to detail and documentation; results orientation
Proven ability to handle multiple projects while meeting deadlines and documenting progress towards those deadlines
Master's or PhD in a quantitative social science field (e.g., psychology, behavioral economics), Business Analytics, or other relevant technical field
5+ Years of client-facing People Analytics, Workforce Strategy, Business Intelligence, or Human Capital Consulting experience, working in/with complex organizations, or combination of education and experience
Preferred Requirements
Experience designing analytics solutions with HR technology to accelerate the employee experience
Proficiency in change management approaches (e.g., PROSCI, etc.)
Proficiency in agile and design-thinking methods
Some experience with LLM/text analysis or interest in learning
Possesses a learning orientation, active exploratory mind, and interest to learn from others
Experience with AWS Cloud suite, Snowflake, Oracle HCM, Service Now, Saba
Experience providing insights on talent management (e.g., talent mobility, DEI, performance, learning and development)

Rapidly perform exploratory data analysis, generate and test working hypotheses, and uncover trends and relationships to support workforce planning efforts; provide descriptive and advanced analyses on workforce and workplace priorities.
Synthesize business goals and strategy with HR, productivity, and market data to build integrated, tangible recommendations on talent and culture topics.
Communicate results of analysis to stakeholders; employ storytelling techniques to make recommendations, moving from the ""so what"" and ""now what,"" to drive impact; develop executive presentations and dashboards for recurring and ad hoc workforce measurement needs.
Build technology and analytical solutions that anticipate business needs across workforce and workplace dimensions; drive digital solutions for self-service.
Project manage key initiatives that drive efficiency and value.
Assist with change management efforts to scale HR analytics solutions across the enterprise.
Assist in development, execution, and evaluation of client OKRs, human capital KPIs and other measurement strategies to enable business results.
Partner and train clients and HR stakeholders on impactful use of data and data literacy techniques to drive business outcomes. Provide guidance on business priorities and opportunities for replication of solutions and self-service to HRA partners.
Advise on enterprise-level and business unit level analytics work with analytics partners through the organization; contribute to enterprise data governance methods and priorities.

Creative and strategic thinker - ability to assess needs, collaborate, and deliver data-driven, practical solutions that drive results

Highly proficient in Excel and PowerPoint
Proficient in data querying languages (e.g., SQL), database management systems, and employee listening platforms (e.g., Perceptyx, Glint)

Master's or PhD in a quantitative social science field (e.g., psychology, behavioral economics), Business Analytics, or other relevant technical field

cond_0167.intro:

We analyze internal and external data to understand diverse employee voices, and experiment to scale solutions that make the work experience better.

The Human Resource Analytics team at [Company name masked] leads the organization's understanding of workforce insights and organizational health. Our team uncovers holistic data-driven business opportunities across the talent lifecycle to enable transformational change and operational efficiency. We analyze internal and external data to understand diverse employee voices, and experiment to scale solutions that make the work experience better.
The ideal candidate sees beyond the numbers to find opportunities to strengthen the employee experience and organizational performance. The candidate is a relentless problem-solver, innovator, and change agent who can translate complex sets of information into actionable talent and culture intelligence. They will own partnership and communication with business clients on workplace insights: diagnosis, hypothesis testing, analysis, visualization, and presentation. They will guide business leaders with data-driven recommendations that improve performance, retention, and organizational agility. The candidate possesses strong quantitative skills, is capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously, and can communicate effectively to a wide-ranging audience. In addition, the candidate is comfortable leading engagement with technology partners as the voice of business to collect business and functional requirements to enhance relevant programs. An ""outside in"" perspective, high intellectual curiosity, and a consultative posture are essential skills to possess in this role.
cond_0242.responsibilities:
The HR Data Science Consultant at [Company name masked] will:
Lead exploratory data analysis, generate and test working hypotheses, and uncover trends and relationships to drive workforce planning efforts; deliver descriptive and advanced analyses on workforce and workplace priorities.
Integrate business goals and strategy with HR, productivity, and market data to produce tangible recommendations on talent and culture topics.
Present results of analysis to stakeholders; employ storytelling techniques to move from the ""so what"" and ""now what"" to clear recommendations; develop executive presentations and dashboards for recurring and ad hoc workforce measurement needs.
Build technology and analytical solutions that anticipate business needs across workforce and workplace dimensions; drive digital solutions for self-service.
Own project management of key initiatives that deliver efficiency and value.
Direct change management efforts to scale HR analytics solutions across the enterprise.
Lead development, execution, and evaluation of client OKRs, human capital KPIs, and other measurement strategies to enable business results.
Train and guide clients and HR stakeholders on impactful use of data and data literacy techniques to drive business outcomes. Provide direction on business priorities and opportunities for replication of solutions and self-service to HRA partners.
Advise on enterprise-level and business unit level analytics work with analytics partners through the organization; set priorities for enterprise data governance methods.
cond_0242.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills — approaches problems with rigorous logic and a curious mind; looks beyond the obvious and searches for deeper answers
Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences; excellent written and verbal communication skills
Highly proficient in Excel and PowerPoint
Proficient in data querying languages (e.g., SQL), database management systems, and employee listening platforms (e.g., Perceptyx, Glint)
Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., Python) and/or mathematical/statistical software (e.g., R), and other advanced analytical tools (e.g., Sagemaker, Tableau, PowerBI, Quicksight, Visier, Alteryx)
Applied statistics or experimentation (A/B testing)
Ability to manage multiple client groups simultaneously; strong project management background
Proven ability to handle multiple projects while meeting deadlines and documenting progress
Master's or PhD in a quantitative social science field (e.g., psychology, behavioral economics), Business Analytics, or other relevant technical field
5+ Years of client-facing People Analytics, Workforce Strategy, Business Intelligence, or Human Capital Consulting experience, working in/with complex organizations, or combination of education and experience
Preferred Requirements
Creative and strategic thinker — ability to assess needs, collaborate, and deliver data-driven, practical solutions
Experience designing analytics solutions with HR technology to accelerate the employee experience
Proficiency in change management approaches (e.g., PROSCI, etc.)
Strong decision-making skills; strong interpersonal, relationship building, and collaboration skills
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and documentation; results orientation
Proficiency in agile and design-thinking methods
Some experience with LLM/text analysis or interest in learning
Learning orientation, active exploratory mind, and interest to learn from others
Experience with AWS Cloud suite, Snowflake, Oracle HCM, Service Now, Saba
Experience providing insights on talent management (e.g., talent mobility, DEI, performance, learning and development)
cond_0242.values: We value achievement and a strong commitment to quality in what we deliver. We aim to set high standards and meet them consistently.

cond_0274.intro:
The Human Resource Analytics team at [Company name masked] leads the organization's understanding of workforce insights and organizational health. Our team uncovers holistic data-driven business opportunities across the talent lifecycle to enable transformational change and operational efficiency. We analyze internal and external data to understand diverse employee voices, and experiment to scale solutions that make the work experience better.
The ideal candidate sees beyond the numbers to find opportunities to strengthen the employee experience and organizational performance. The candidate is relentless problem-solver, innovator and change agent who can translate complex sets of information into actionable talent and culture intelligence. They are responsible for partnership and communication with business clients on workplace insights: diagnosis, hypothesis testing, analysis, visualization, and presentation. They will guide business leaders with data-driven recommendations that improve performance, retention, and organizational agility. The candidate possesses strong quantitative skills, is capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously, and can communicate effectively to a wide-ranging audience. In addition, the candidate is comfortable working with technology partners as the voice of business to collect business and functional requirements to enhance relevant programs. An ""outside in"" perspective, high intellectual curiosity, and a consultative posture are essential skills to possess in this role. People who do well here often find that the logic of HR data and workforce analysis clicks for them fairly quickly.
cond_0274.responsibilities:
The HR Data Science Consultant at [Company name masked] will:
Rapidly perform exploratory data analysis, generate and test working hypotheses, and uncover trends and relationships to support workforce planning efforts; provide descriptive and advanced analyses on workforce and workplace priorities.
Synthesize business goals and strategy with HR, productivity, and market data to build integrated, tangible recommendations on talent and culture topics.
Communicate results of analysis to stakeholders; employ storytelling techniques to make recommendations, moving from the ""so what"" and ""now what,"" to drive impact; develop executive presentations and dashboards for recurring and ad hoc workforce measurement needs.
Build technology and analytical solutions that anticipate business needs across workforce and workplace dimensions; drive digital solutions for self-service.
Project manage key initiatives that drive efficiency and value.
Assist with change management efforts to scale HR analytics solutions across the enterprise.
Assist in development, execution, and evaluation of client OKRs, human capital KPIs and other measurement strategies to enable business results.
Partner and train clients and HR stakeholders on impactful use of data and data literacy techniques to drive business outcomes. Provide guidance on business priorities and opportunities for replication of solutions and self-service to HRA partners.
Advise on enterprise-level and business unit level analytics work with analytics partners through the organization; contribute to enterprise data governance methods and priorities.

cond_0342.intro:
The Human Resource Analytics team at [Company name masked] works to build the organization's understanding of workforce insights and organizational health. Together, we uncover data-driven opportunities across the talent lifecycle to support transformational change and operational efficiency. We analyze internal and external data to understand diverse employee voices, and work collaboratively to scale solutions that improve the work experience.
The ideal candidate looks beyond the numbers to find opportunities to strengthen the employee experience and organizational performance. They are a problem-solver and innovator who can translate complex information into actionable talent and culture intelligence. They are comfortable working alongside business clients on workplace insights: diagnosis, hypothesis testing, analysis, visualization, and presentation, and can help guide business leaders with data-driven recommendations that improve performance, retention, and organizational agility. The candidate has strong quantitative skills, can manage multiple projects at once, and communicates effectively with a wide-ranging audience. They are also comfortable working with technology partners as the voice of business to gather requirements and enhance relevant programs. An ""outside in"" perspective, intellectual curiosity, and a consultative approach are essential in this role.
cond_0342.responsibilities:
The HR Data Scientist at [Company name masked] will:
Work with cross-functional partners to perform exploratory data analysis, test working hypotheses, and uncover trends and relationships that support workforce planning efforts; contribute descriptive and advanced analyses on workforce and workplace priorities.
Coordinate with HR and business stakeholders to synthesize goals and strategy with HR, productivity, and market data, building integrated, tangible recommendations on talent and culture topics.
Share results of analysis with stakeholders; use storytelling techniques to move from the ""so what"" and ""now what"" to inform decisions; develop executive presentations and dashboards for recurring and ad hoc workforce measurement needs.
Collaborate with technology and analytical partners to build solutions that anticipate business needs across workforce and workplace dimensions; support digital solutions for self-service.
Coordinate key initiatives to drive efficiency and value.
Support change management efforts to scale HR analytics solutions across the enterprise.
Assist in the development, execution, and evaluation of client OKRs, human capital KPIs, and other measurement strategies alongside business partners.
Partner with and train clients and HR stakeholders on impactful use of data and data literacy techniques. Help identify opportunities for replication of solutions and self-service with HRA partners.
Work alongside analytics partners across the organization on enterprise-level and business unit analytics; contribute to shared enterprise data governance methods and priorities.
cond_0342.requirements:
Creative and strategic thinker - ability to assess needs, collaborate, and deliver data-driven, practical solutions that drive results
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills - approaches problems with rigorous logic and a curious mind – looks beyond the obvious and searches for deeper answers
Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences – tells stories with data that resonate with stakeholders and maximize impact; excellent written and verbal communication skills
Experience designing analytics solutions with HR technology to accelerate the employee experience
Ability to manage multiple client groups simultaneously; strong project management background
Highly proficient in Excel and PowerPoint
Proficient in data querying languages (e.g., SQL), database management systems, and employee listening platforms (e.g., Perceptyx, Glint)
Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., Python) and/or mathematical/statistical software (e.g., R), and other advanced analytical tools (e.g., Sagemaker, Tableau, PowerBI, Quicksight, Visier, Alteryx)
Applied statistics or experimentation (A/B testing)
Proficiency in change management approaches (e.g., PROSCI, etc.)
Strong decision-making skills; stellar interpersonal, relationship building, and collaboration skills
Highly-organized with strong attention to detail and documentation; results orientation
Proven ability to handle multiple projects while meeting deadlines and documenting progress towards those deadlines
Proficiency in agile and design-thinking methods
Some experience with LLM/text analysis or interest in learning
Possesses a learning orientation, active exploratory mind, and interest to learn from others
Experience with AWS Cloud suite, Snowflake, Oracle HCM, Service Now, Saba a plus
Master's or PhD in a quantitative social science field (e.g., psychology, behavioral economics), Business Analytics, or other relevant technical field
5+ Years of client-facing People Analytics, Workforce Strategy, Business Intelligence, or Human Capital Consulting experience, working in/with complex organizations, or combination of education and experience
Experience providing insights on talent management (e.g., talent mobility, DEI, performance, learning and development)

cond_0376.intro:
The Human Resource Analytics team at [Company name masked] leads the organization's understanding of workforce insights and organizational health. The team uncovers data-driven business opportunities across the talent lifecycle to support operational efficiency. We analyze internal and external data to understand diverse employee voices, and test solutions that improve the work experience.
This role focuses on translating complex data into actionable talent and culture intelligence. The candidate looks beyond the numbers to find opportunities to strengthen employee experience and organizational performance. They are a rigorous problem-solver who can turn complex information into clear, usable recommendations. Responsibilities include diagnosis, hypothesis testing, analysis, visualization, and sharing findings with business clients on workplace insights. The candidate will support business leaders with data-driven recommendations that improve performance, retention, and organizational agility. Strong quantitative skills, the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, and clear communication are required. The candidate is also comfortable working with technology partners to gather business and functional requirements for relevant programs. An outside-in perspective, intellectual curiosity, and a consultative approach are essential.

Document and share results of analysis with relevant stakeholders; apply structured storytelling techniques to move from findings to recommendations; develop executive presentations and dashboards for recurring and ad hoc workforce measurement needs.
Build technology and analytical solutions that address business needs across workforce and workplace dimensions; support digital solutions for self-service.
Project manage key initiatives that improve efficiency and deliver value.
Support change management efforts to scale HR analytics solutions across the enterprise.
Assist in development, execution, and evaluation of client OKRs, human capital KPIs, and other measurement strategies to support business results.
Train clients and HR stakeholders on effective use of data and data literacy techniques. Provide guidance on business priorities and opportunities for solution replication and self-service to HRA partners.
Contribute to enterprise-level and business unit level analytics work with analytics partners across the organization; support enterprise data governance methods and priorities.

The Human Resource Analytics team at [Company name masked] leads the organization's understanding of workforce insights and organizational health. Our team uncovers holistic data-driven business opportunities across the talent lifecycle to enable transformational change and operational efficiency. We analyze internal and external data to understand diverse employee voices, and experiment to scale solutions that make the work experience better.
The ideal candidate sees beyond the numbers to find opportunities to strengthen the employee experience and organizational performance. The candidate is a relentless problem-solver, innovator and change agent who can translate complex sets of information into actionable talent and culture intelligence. They own partnership and communication with business clients on workplace insights: diagnosis, hypothesis testing, analysis, visualization, and presentation. They will guide business leaders with data-driven recommendations that improve performance, retention, and organizational agility. The candidate possesses strong quantitative skills, is capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously, and can communicate effectively to a wide-ranging audience. In addition, the candidate is comfortable working with technology partners as the voice of business to collect business and functional requirements to enhance relevant programs. An ""outside in"" perspective, high intellectual curiosity, and a consultative posture are essential skills to possess in this role.
cond_0485.responsibilities:
The HR Data Science Consultant at [Company name masked] will:
Rapidly execute exploratory data analysis, generate and test working hypotheses, and uncover trends and relationships to drive workforce planning efforts; deliver descriptive and advanced analyses on workforce and workplace priorities.
Synthesize business goals and strategy with HR, productivity, and market data to build integrated, tangible recommendations on talent and culture topics.
Communicate results of analysis to stakeholders; employ storytelling techniques to make recommendations, moving from the ""so what"" and ""now what,"" to drive impact; develop executive presentations and dashboards for recurring and ad hoc workforce measurement needs.
Build technology and analytical solutions that anticipate business needs across workforce and workplace dimensions; lead digital solutions for self-service.
Direct key initiatives that drive efficiency and value.
Lead change management efforts to scale HR analytics solutions across the enterprise.
Own development, execution, and evaluation of client OKRs, human capital KPIs and other measurement strategies to enable business results.
Train and guide clients and HR stakeholders on impactful use of data and data literacy techniques to drive business outcomes. Determine business priorities and opportunities for replication of solutions and self-service to HRA partners.
Advise on enterprise-level and business unit level analytics work with analytics partners through the organization; set direction on enterprise data governance methods and priorities.
cond_0485.requirements:
Creative and strategic thinker - ability to assess needs, collaborate, and deliver data-driven, practical solutions that drive results
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills - approaches problems with rigorous logic and a curious mind – looks beyond the obvious and searches for deeper answers
Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences – tells stories with data that resonate with stakeholders and maximize impact; excellent written and verbal communication skills
Experience designing analytics solutions with HR technology to accelerate the employee experience
Ability to manage multiple client groups simultaneously; strong project management background
Highly proficient in Excel and PowerPoint
Proficient in data querying languages (e.g., SQL), database management systems, and employee listening platforms (e.g., Perceptyx, Glint)
Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., Python) and/or mathematical/statistical software (e.g., R), and other advanced analytical tools (e.g., Sagemaker, Tableau, PowerBI, Quicksight, Visier, Alteryx)
Applied statistics or experimentation (A/B testing)
Proficiency in change management approaches (e.g., PROSCI, etc.)
Strong decision-making skills; stellar interpersonal, relationship building, and collaboration skills
Highly-organized with strong attention to detail and documentation; results orientation
Proven ability to handle multiple projects while meeting deadlines and documenting progress towards those deadlines
Proficiency in agile and design-thinking methods
Some experience with LLM/text analysis or interest in learning
Possesses a learning orientation, active exploratory mind, and interest to learn from others
Experience with AWS Cloud suite, Snowflake, Oracle HCM, Service Now, Saba a plus
Master's or PhD in a quantitative social science field (e.g., psychology, behavioral economics), Business Analytics, or other relevant technical field
5+ Years of client-facing People Analytics, Workforce Strategy, Business Intelligence, or Human Capital Consulting experience, working in/with complex organizations, or combination of education and experience
Experience providing insights on talent management (e.g., talent mobility, DEI, performance, learning and development)

cond_0548.intro:
The Human Resource Analytics team at [Company name masked] leads the organization's understanding of workforce insights and organizational health. Our team uncovers holistic data-driven business opportunities across the talent lifecycle to enable transformational change and operational efficiency. We analyze internal and external data to understand diverse employee voices, and experiment to scale solutions that make the work experience better.
The ideal candidate sees beyond the numbers to find opportunities to strengthen the employee experience and organizational performance. The candidate is a relentless problem-solver, innovator, and change agent who can translate complex sets of information into actionable talent and culture intelligence. They will own partnership and communication with business clients on workplace insights: diagnosis, hypothesis testing, analysis, visualization, and presentation. They will guide business leaders with data-driven recommendations that improve performance, retention, and organizational agility. The candidate possesses strong quantitative skills, is capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously, and can communicate effectively to a wide-ranging audience. In addition, the candidate is comfortable leading engagement with technology partners as the voice of business to collect business and functional requirements to enhance relevant programs. An ""outside in"" perspective, high intellectual curiosity, and a consultative posture are essential skills to possess in this role.
cond_0548.responsibilities:
The HR Data Science Consultant at [Company name masked] will:
Lead exploratory data analysis, generate and test working hypotheses, and uncover trends and relationships to drive workforce planning efforts; deliver descriptive and advanced analyses on workforce and workplace priorities.
Integrate business goals and strategy with HR, productivity, and market data to produce tangible recommendations on talent and culture topics.
Present results of analysis to stakeholders; employ storytelling techniques to move from the ""so what"" and ""now what"" to clear recommendations; develop executive presentations and dashboards for recurring and ad hoc workforce measurement needs.
Build technology and analytical solutions that anticipate business needs across workforce and workplace dimensions; drive digital solutions for self-service.
Own project management of key initiatives that deliver efficiency and value.
Direct change management efforts to scale HR analytics solutions across the enterprise.
Lead development, execution, and evaluation of client OKRs, human capital KPIs, and other measurement strategies to enable business results.
Train and guide clients and HR stakeholders on impactful use of data and data literacy techniques to drive business outcomes. Provide direction on business priorities and opportunities for replication of solutions and self-service to HRA partners.
Advise on enterprise-level and business unit level analytics work with analytics partners through the organization; set priorities for enterprise data governance methods.
cond_0548.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills — approaches problems with rigorous logic and a curious mind; looks beyond the obvious and searches for deeper answers
Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences; excellent written and verbal communication skills
Highly proficient in Excel and PowerPoint
Proficient in data querying languages (e.g., SQL), database management systems, and employee listening platforms (e.g., Perceptyx, Glint)
Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., Python) and/or mathematical/statistical software (e.g., R), and other advanced analytical tools (e.g., Sagemaker, Tableau, PowerBI, Quicksight, Visier, Alteryx)
Applied statistics or experimentation (A/B testing)
Ability to manage multiple client groups simultaneously; strong project management background
Proven ability to handle multiple projects while meeting deadlines and documenting progress
Master's or PhD in a quantitative social science field (e.g., psychology, behavioral economics), Business Analytics, or other relevant technical field
5+ Years of client-facing People Analytics, Workforce Strategy, Business Intelligence, or Human Capital Consulting experience, working in/with complex organizations, or combination of education and experience
Preferred Requirements
Creative and strategic thinker — ability to assess needs, collaborate, and deliver data-driven, practical solutions
Experience designing analytics solutions with HR technology to accelerate the employee experience
Proficiency in change management approaches (e.g., PROSCI, etc.)
Strong decision-making skills; strong interpersonal, relationship building, and collaboration skills
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and documentation; results orientation
Proficiency in agile and design-thinking methods
Some experience with LLM/text analysis or interest in learning
Learning orientation, active exploratory mind, and interest to learn from others
Experience with AWS Cloud suite, Snowflake, Oracle HCM, Service Now, Saba
Experience providing insights on talent management (e.g., talent mobility, DEI, performance, learning and development)
